content.title: JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run release schedule: when is episode 2 releasing on Netflix?
content.text: (Image credit: Lucky Land Communications/Shueisha, JoJo's Animation SBR Project) JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run out on Netflix, but where is episode 2? It's a good question, especially as the streamer hasn't provided the information and the anime series has had a patchy history of release drops on the streamer.We won't be horsing around here: below, you'll find our speculation on the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run episode 2 release date and streaming time in the US and UK, plus some more talk about episode counts and schedules. Let's hope it avoids the controversy of Stone Ocean...Latest Videos From GamesRadar+JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run release date: what time is episode 2 streaming on Netflix? (Image credit: Lucky Land Communications/Shueisha, JoJo's Animation SBR Project)If following a traditional weekly schedule, JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run episode 2 should be out on March 26 at midnight Pacific/3:00 AM Eastern.We don't believe that will be the case, however.Instead, we anticipate JoJo's won't release a new episode just yet - and will deliver more concrete information about its release plans during its AnimeJapan panel on March 28. Stay tuned, and we'll update this page as soon as we hear more.Jojo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run release schedule: when are new episodes out? (Image credit: Lucky Land Communications/Shueisha, JoJo's Animation SBR Project)As of right now, only one episode of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run has been confirmed: the premiere, a bumper-length entry entitled '1st STAGE'.Bringing all the latest movie news, features, and reviews to your inboxIn the past, Netflix has drawn fans' ire by dropping the entire first cour for Stone Ocean and then leaving fans empty-handed for another eight months. It appears the streamer may have learned its lesson, but we're still none the wiser on when new episodes will be released.For now, here's the current confirmed JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run release scheduleJoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run episode 1: March 19, 2026JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run episode 2: TBAWhere to watch JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run and episode count speculation (Image credit: Lucky Land Communications/Shueisha, JoJo's Animation SBR Project)JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Steel Ball Run, which follows a unique cross-country horseback race in 19th Century America, will be streaming exclusively on Netflix.While no episode count has been confirmed, we can expect more news at this month's AnimeJapan. We anticipate, however, that it will likely last for around 38-40 episodes, in line with previous seasons. Only one episode has aired so far.Need something new to watch?
